limitations: Whole-fleet logical workload cycles, not per-Drive or physical IOPS.
One ordered short local control, not full10000client/5000partition/1000file qualification, crosshost or mounted CLI capacity.
Selected counter windows bracket activework and include capture/background skew; active clocks exclude observers and idle liveness.
SQL/SDK/HTTP/core spans are inclusive overlapping wall time, not exclusive CPU or TiDB serverlockwait.
Returned/serialized JSON counters exclude MySQL framing and are not physical replication or disk bytes; root/file guard bytes lack separate labels.
Byte-only core counters have no dedicated JSON encode/decode timing.
HTTP successfulPUT empty response body drops are expected; GET endpoints reach EOF.
HTTP body bytes are observed before adapter validation; warm generic adapter cache changes payloadGET traffic.
Cache/gauge maxima are endpoint observations, not monotonic deltas; allocation profiling disabled.
Strict policy and fresh read/reopen checks do not establish crash or powerloss qualification.
No hostiostat or physicalNVMe/deviceIO attribution; no claim compression caused rate changes.
Native successful ownership path settles leader/group; no separate benchmark_group_absent receiptfield emitted.
